styling and personal brand design

work with our stylist and personal brand experts for your next photoshoot in our Budapest studio

Add professional styling to your photoshoot for a more polished, cohesive and camera-ready result. From one fully styled look to multi-look concepts and full brand-focused styling, our stylist helps shape the outfits, mood and visual direction of the session. Styling can be used for portraits, model portfolios, personal branding, glamour, boudoir, creative editorial shoots, commercial campaigns, lookbooks and brand content. It can also be booked together with photography, makeup and hair in one place.

Standard Styling Package

For one fully styled look during your photoshoot. Ideal if you want a polished outfit selected specifically for the concept, with professional styling that makes the final images feel more intentional and complete.

35.000. HUF

  • 1 fully styled look
  • outfit concept and direction
  • clothing and accessory sourcing
  • fitting and final styling on set

Signature Styling Package

For photoshoots with multiple outfits or a more defined visual direction. Best if you want a cohesive set of looks for portraits, model portfolio, branding, glamour or creative images.

55.000. HUF

  • 2-3 fully styled look
  • outfit concept and direction
  • clothing and accessory sourcing
  • fitting and final styling on set

Personal Brand Design & Styling

For clients who need a stronger, more strategic visual identity. Ideal for entrepreneurs, creatives, coaches, performers and personal brands who want images that feel consistent, intentional and aligned with their work.

75.000. HUF

  • personal brand visual direction
  • styling concept for the photoshoot
  • outfit planning for multiple uses
  • mood, color and image direction
  • recommended for branding shoots and campaigns
